```sql
SELECT l."ID", COUNT(*) AS abnormal_got_count
FROM main."Laboratory" l
JOIN main."Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."Date" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND l."Date" <= '1997-12-31'
  AND l."GOT" >= 60
  AND l."Date" < '1998-06-01'
GROUP BY l."ID"
ORDER BY l."ID";
```
